# Quantum chemistry input fixtures

The `water_*`, `oh_*` files are original ReShiki golden outputs. Run
`RESHIKI_BLESS=1 cargo test -p reshiki-io qc_input` to regenerate them. File names
use the program's lowercase name and the job's serialized kebab-case name.
Companions keep the main golden's prefix, for example
`water_orca_transition-state_xtb.hess` (written as `water_xtb.hess`) and
`water_orca_neb-ts_product.xyz`.

Water is O `(0, 0, 0)`, H `(0.9572, 0, 0)`, H
`(-0.2399872, 0.9266272, 0)`, with charge 0 and multiplicity 1. The default
settings use template 1, except GAMESS uses `6-31G(d)` because its built-in
bases cannot represent template 1's `def2-SVP`. Endpoint frames move both H
atoms by +0.05 Å (reactant) or −0.05 Å (product) in x. The synthetic Hessian
uses `H[i,j] = 0.1 / (1 + abs(i-j))`. The synthetic vibrational frequencies
are −412.3, 1600 and 3700 cm⁻¹.

All files below are copied byte-for-byte from the supplied upstream fixture
snapshots. The cclib revision is
`1ed6fb7b7d0b95f2767c12071e22841e18bb845e`; the pymatgen-test-files revision is
`85005108e99e40cbd59e78f067459b0ca664efc6`. The structure checkers are
original ReShiki code.

The structure checkers accept optional Link 0 lines, continuation route lines,
and program-appropriate whitespace found in the original files. Generated
GAMESS files additionally enforce the 80-column limit and column-2 groups.

## Keyword sources

Checked on 2026-11-25. Manuals: Gaussian 16 keyword pages (gaussian.com), the ORCA 6.1.1 manual
(faccts.de and orca-manual.mpi-muelheim.mpg.de), the GAMESS-US input documentation dated
15 Jul 2024 (msg.chem.iastate.edu/gamess/GAMESS_Manual/docs-input.txt and docs-intro.txt).
"Sample" means one of the third-party files above uses the same form.

| Program  | What we write                                                                                                     | Source                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Gaussian | `%nprocshared=N`, `%mem=NGB`, `%chk=name.chk`                                                                     | https://gaussian.com/link0/ (`%Mem` accepts GB); samples `dvb_un_sp.gjf` (`%nproc`, `%mem=6GB`, `%chk`)                                                                                                      |
| Gaussian | `!` comment line                                                                                                  | https://gaussian.com/input/ ("Comments begin with an exclamation point (!), which may appear anywhere on a line")                                                                                            |
| Gaussian | section order and blank-line terminators                                                                          | https://gaussian.com/input/; samples `C60_gau.com`, `dvb_dispersion_bp86_d3zero.in`                                                                                                                          |
| Gaussian | `U` prefix for open shells (`UB3LYP`)                                                                             | sample `dvb_un_sp.gjf` (`ub3lyp/sto-3g`)                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Gaussian | `EmpiricalDispersion=GD3BJ` / `GD3`                                                                               | https://gaussian.com/dft/; sample `dvb_dispersion_bp86_d3zero.in` (`empiricaldispersion=gd3`)                                                                                                                |
| Gaussian | `Def2SVP` etc. for `def2-SVP`, `Def2SVPP` for `def2-SV(P)`                                                        | https://gaussian.com/basissets/ ("all other names follow those in the paper with the hyphen removed")                                                                                                        |
| Gaussian | `Opt=(TS,CalcFC,NoEigenTest) Freq`                                                                                | https://gaussian.com/opt/ (TS, CalcFC, NoEigenTest; Opt combines with Freq)                                                                                                                                  |
| Gaussian | `Opt=QST2 Freq`, `Opt=QST3 Freq`: reactant, product (, TS guess) sections, same atom order                        | https://gaussian.com/opt/                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Gaussian | `IRC=(CalcFC,MaxPoints=N)`                                                                                        | https://gaussian.com/irc/ (one of RCFC/CalcFC is required; MaxPoints default 10)                                                                                                                             |
| ORCA     | `#` comments, `!` keyword line, `* xyz charge mult` … `*`                                                         | https://www.faccts.de/docs/orca/6.1/manual/contents/essentialelements/input.html; samples `dvb_ir.inp`, `dvb_gopt.inp`                                                                                       |
| ORCA     | `UKS` / `UHF` for open shells                                                                                     | sample `dvb_sp_un_dft.inp` (`! uks b3lyp`)                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ORCA     | `D3BJ`, `D3ZERO`                                                                                                  | https://www.faccts.de/docs/orca/6.1/manual/contents/modelchemistries/dispersioncorrections.html; sample `dvb_dispersion_bp86_d3zero.inp` (`d3zero`)                                                          |
| ORCA     | `%pal nprocs N end`                                                                                               | ORCA 6.1 manual, parallel section (`%pal nprocs 4 end`); sample `dvb_ir.inp`                                                                                                                                 |
| ORCA     | `%maxcore` = 75 % of memory per core (MB)                                                                         | input.html ("This limit applies per processing core … no more than 75-80% of your physical memory"); sample `dvb_ir.inp` (`%MaxCore 700`)                                                                    |
| ORCA     | `SP`, `Opt`, `Opt Freq`, `OptTS Freq`                                                                             | https://www.faccts.de/docs/orca/6.1/manual/contents/structurereactivity/optimizations.html, …/frequencies.html, …/optimizations_TS.html                                                                      |
| ORCA     | `%geom InHess Read InHessName "x.hess" end`, `Calc_Hess true`                                                     | https://orca-manual.mpi-muelheim.mpg.de/contents/structurereactivity/optimizations_TS.html (ORCA 6.1.1)                                                                                                      |
| ORCA     | no `TS_Mode` line: `{M 0}` (lowest mode) is the default                                                           | same page, keyword table: "`TS_Mode {M 0}` Follow eigenvector 0 (lowest mode)"                                                                                                                               |
| ORCA     | `IRC`, `%irc MaxIter N InitHess read Hess_Filename "x.hess" end`                                                  | https://www.faccts.de/docs/orca/6.1/manual/contents/structurereactivity/irc.html                                                                                                                             |
| ORCA     | `NEB-TS Freq`, `%neb NEB_End_XYZFile "p.xyz" NEB_TS_XYZFile "ts.xyz" NImages N end`, reactant inline              | https://www.faccts.de/docs/orca/6.1/manual/contents/structurereactivity/neb.html; NEB-TS tutorial https://www.faccts.de/docs/orca/6.1/tutorials/react/nebts.html (`!PBEh-3c NEB-TS FREQ`, `NEB_END_XYZFILE`) |
| ORCA     | `.hess`: `$orca_hessian_file`, `$hessian` (3N, blocks of columns), `$atoms` (symbol, mass, x y z in bohr), `$end` | ORCA 6.1 manual, Vibrational Spectroscopy → Isotope shifts (`.hess` excerpt); layout compared with an ORCA-written `.hess` (not copied)                                                                      |
| GAMESS   | `!` comment cards between groups; groups start with ` $` in column 2                                              | docs-intro.txt ("comment cards may be placed between namelist groups"; "$ sign in column 2")                                                                                                                 |
| GAMESS   | `$CONTRL SCFTYP RUNTYP DFTTYP MPLEVL ICHARG MULT UNITS`                                                           | docs-input.txt `$CONTRL`; samples `dvb_un_sp.inp` (`SCFTYP=UHF … MULT=2 ICHARG=1`), `dvb_gopt_a.inp`                                                                                                         |
| GAMESS   | `RUNTYP=SADPOINT`, `$STATPT HESS=CALC NSTEP=… HSSEND=.T.`                                                         | docs-input.txt `$STATPT` (HESS=CALC computes the Hessian; HSSEND evaluates the Hessian after a successful search)                                                                                            |
| GAMESS   | `$SYSTEM MWORDS` per core                                                                                         | docs-input.txt ("maximum replicated memory which your job can use, on every core … 1,000,000 words")                                                                                                         |
| GAMESS   | `$BASIS GBASIS=N31 NGAUSS=6 NDFUNC=1`, `GBASIS=STO NGAUSS=3`                                                      | docs-input.txt `$BASIS`; sample `dvb_un_sp.inp` (`GBASIS=STO NGAUSS=3`)                                                                                                                                      |
| GAMESS   | `$DFT DC=.T. IDCVER=4` (D3BJ) / `IDCVER=3` (D3)                                                                   | docs-input.txt `$DFT` ("= 4 means modified 3rd implementation DFT-D3(BJ)"); sample `dvb_dispersion_bp86_d3zero.inp` (`DC=.T. IDCVER=3`)                                                                      |
| GAMESS   | `$DATA` title, `C1`, `SYMBOL ZNUC X Y Z`                                                                          | docs-input.txt `$DATA` (no blank card after C1); sample `nh3_ts_ir.inp`                                                                                                                                      |

The ORCA Hessian companion is named `<stem>_xtb.hess`, not `<stem>.hess`: an `OptTS Freq` job writes its own `<stem>.hess` when its frequency step finishes, which would replace the xTB Hessian a rerun reads.
